title: Add consent, purpose and notice-version fields to the User document
description: In onfinance_db_model_master/models.py, class User(Document) (lines 387-429, repo onfinance-db-model-master, local checkout applications/db-models/repos/onfinance-db-model-master), add five optional fields: consent_id = StringField(); consent_purposes = ListField(StringField(), default=list); notice_version = StringField(); consent_given_at = DateTimeField(); consent_withdrawn_at = DateTimeField(). Validate consent_purposes and notice_version against the purpose and notice ids from task 1 (choices=, or a clean() method that rejects unknown ids). Do not add required=True to any field: existing documents must keep loading and no data migration is in scope. Leave account_creation_date unchanged. In setup.py, bump version from 1.0.0 to 1.1.0. Follow sdlc/policy.json releaseProcess: normal change, one approval, rollback plan required, promotion order dev, qa, prod. db-models has no deploymentWindows or changeFreeze defined.
acceptanceCriteria: grep -nE 'consent_id|consent_purposes|notice_version|consent_given_at|consent_withdrawn_at' onfinance_db_model_master/models.py shows all five fields inside class User
User(user_full_name='x', consent_purposes=['not-in-register']).validate() raises ValidationError, and a User built with register ids validates.
A User document stored without any of the new fields loads through User.objects.first() with no FieldDoesNotExist or ValidationError.

verificationMethod.description: Run probe-schemas for db-models/onfinance-db-model-master on the merged commit. Expected result: rule SCH-RET-01 no longer reports a fail for onfinance_db_model_master/models.py, the run does not produce fingerprint 3bbf3f6eb8287d913a4d5a671c846297a7b97c1763e33aad781d5fabe870e42a, and the observation for sebi-cscrf-2024:GV.OC.S2 on this repo is satisfied.

rootCause.description: User was designed as a profile-and-activity store. It never got fields linking a record to the consent, purpose and notice under which its personal data was collected, so consent cannot be shown per record.
